findings.title: Sharon Regional Medical Center suspends critical heart care
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Sharon Regional’s heart catheterization lab suspended procedures about six weeks ago.
findings.service_line: Cardiac catheterization/interventional heart attack care; ambulance intake for cardiac, stroke and trauma cases
findings.access_consequences: The hospital reportedly suspended its cardiac catheterization procedures roughly six weeks before the October 29 report. An EMS official said the nearest mechanical clot-removal cardiac facility is about 40 minutes away and county EMS agencies were notified on October 28 that Sharon Regional was not accepting stroke, cardiac or trauma ambulance patients. Ongoing diversions for specialized care were reported. Hospital management did not confirm the report; duration, exact scope and restoration timing unknown.
findings.affected_population: Mercer County-area patients needing time-critical cardiac catheterization and stroke, cardiac or trauma ambulance transport; numbers affected unknown.
